# Lineup Confirmed

> Starting goalies, probable pitchers and game-day lineups, each marked expected or confirmed with its source.

Lineup Confirmed tracks who is starting today across sports: NHL starting goalies, MLB probable pitchers and closers, NBA injury status, Premier League lineups and NFL starting quarterbacks. Every starter is labeled expected or confirmed and linked to its source.

Search and AI crawlers may read this site. Published articles list public sources. Cite the article URL and those sources when you rely on a story.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lineupconfirmed.com/): Latest stories

- [NHL Starting Goalies](https://lineupconfirmed.com/nhl/starting-goalies/): Tonight's NHL starters, game by game, marked expected or confirmed with the team or reporter source.

- [NBA Injury Status](https://lineupconfirmed.com/nba/injury-status/): Who is in, out or questionable tonight, from official team and league reports.

- [Premier League Lineups](https://lineupconfirmed.com/soccer/premier-league-lineups/): Confirmed Premier League starting elevens, published when clubs release them.

- [NFL Starting QBs](https://lineupconfirmed.com/nfl/starting-qbs/): Quarterback starts, benchings and injuries. News only, no fantasy advice.

- [MLB Probable Pitchers](https://lineupconfirmed.com/mlb/probable-pitchers/): Probable starting pitchers for every game, from club announcements.

- [MLB Closers](https://lineupconfirmed.com/mlb/closers/): Closer and bullpen role changes, sourced to managers and team reporters.

- [Archive](https://lineupconfirmed.com/archive/): Every published story

The NHL Emergency Backup Goalie Rule Explained](https://lineupconfirmed.com/articles/nhl-emergency-backup-goalie-ebug-rule-explained/): An EBUG is an emergency backup goalie: a local amateur on a list kept by the home team, available to either club if it cannot dress or keep two goaltenders. Most never leave the bench, but a few have played, and one won.
